scripts.db:deploy: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/system/schema.prisma && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/tenant/schema.prisma && cd ../..
scripts.db:status: cd apps/backend && npx prisma migrate status --schema ./prisma/system/schema.prisma && npx prisma migrate status --schema ./prisma/tenant/schema.prisma && cd ../..
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed && pnpm db:seed:admin
scripts.dev:mfes: concurrently --names "core,orders,reserv,kitchen,cashier,menu" --prefix-colors "cyan,blue,magenta,yellow,red,green" --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm dev:core" "pnpm dev:orders" "pnpm dev:reserv" "pnpm dev:kitchen" "pnpm dev:cashier" "pnpm dev:menu"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "shell,core,orders,reserv,kitchen,cashier,menu" --prefix-colors "bgBlue,cyan,blue,magenta,yellow,red,green" --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm dev:shell" "pnpm dev:core" "pnpm dev:orders" "pnpm dev:reserv" "pnpm dev:kitchen" "pnpm dev:cashier" "pnpm dev:menu"
scripts.build:mfes: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:orders && pnpm build:reserv && pnpm build:kitchen && pnpm build:cashier && pnpm build:menu
scripts.build:sequential: pnpm build:shell && pnpm build:core && pnpm build:orders && pnpm build:reserv && pnpm build:kitchen && pnpm build:cashier && pnpm build:menu
